# XCiT

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/xcit.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/xcit.py) ·
**Architectures:** 28 · **Pretrained weights:** 42 (42 with ImageNet-1k results)

Cross-Covariance Image Transformers (XCiT) replace token self-attention with cross-covariance attention across feature
channels, linear in the number of tokens, and add local patch interaction layers.

## Papers

* [XCiT: Cross-Covariance Image Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09681)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('xcit_small_12_p8_224.fb_dist_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`Xcit` with `xcit_nano_12_p8_224` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
